title: Cookies
intro: We don't use tracking or advertising cookies.
body:
## On this website

We don't set any tracking, analytics or advertising cookies. Visit counts are anonymous and cookie-free.

If you confirm your age for the Romance section, we save that choice in your browser's local storage so you aren't asked again. It's never sent to us.

## On other sites we link to

Payhip (checkout), Kit (sign-ups), Amazon, Kobo, Google Play and Instagram set their own cookies on their own sites. Their privacy policies explain how.
